reti.idea: White develops the knight first and hits your d5 pawn from the side with c4, hoping you overextend. Stay calm: back d5 up with ...e6, castle quickly, and only take on c4 once White's king has castled and d4 is played.

moves.3:e6: Support d5 with a pawn so c4xd5 can be met by ...exd5.
moves.5:Nf6: Develop and guard d5 a second time.
moves.7:Be7: Quiet development; gets ready to castle.
moves.9:O-O: King safe before the centre opens.
moves.11:dxc4: Now that d4 is in, grab c4 — White needs time to win it back.

kia.idea: White sets up a slow fianchetto (Nf3, g3, Bg2, O-O, d3, Nbd2) and later pushes e4. Build a classical centre with ...d5 and ...e6, castle, then gain space on the queenside with ...c5.

moves.3:Nf6: Develop and control e4, White's key square.
moves.5:e6: Solid pawn chain; opens the way for the dark bishop.
moves.9:O-O: King safe before White pushes e4.
moves.11:c5: Grab queenside space — your counterplay while White plays on the kingside.

english.idea: 1.c4 is a Sicilian with colours reversed. Answer with ...e5 and quick development; after ...d5 and the trade on d5 your knight drops back to b6, where it hits c4 and stays safe.

moves.1:e5: Take a central square White isn't controlling.
moves.5:d5: Strike in the centre while White is busy with g3.
moves.7:Nxd5: Recapture with the knight; it's centralised.
moves.9:Nb6: Step out of the Bg2 pin on the long diagonal and away from Nxd5 trades.

london.idea: White plays the same setup every game: d4, Bf4, e3, c3, Bd3. Mirror it solidly with ...d5, ...Nf6, ...e6, challenge the bishop with ...Bd6, castle, and hit the centre with ...c5.

moves.7:Bd6: Offer a bishop trade — the Bf4 is White's best piece.
moves.11:c5: Challenge d4; this is your main counterplay.
moves.13:Nc6: Pile up on d4 and develop the last minor piece.

qg.idea: It isn't a real gambit: c4 can be taken back. Hold the centre with ...e6 (Queen's Gambit Declined), develop calmly, castle, and ask the Bg5 a question with ...h6.

moves.3:e6: Defend d5 with a pawn — the solid Declined.
moves.7:Be7: Break the pin on your f6 knight.
moves.11:h6: Make the bishop decide: trade on f6 or retreat.

italian.idea: White aims the bishop at f7 and wants c3 and d4. Mirror with ...Bc5, hit e4 with ...Nf6, and when White pushes d4, take and give a check on b4 — then ...Nxe4 wins a central pawn.

moves.5:Bc5: Aim at f2, just like White aims at f7.
moves.9:exd4: Take — keeping tension loses the bishop's square.
moves.11:Bb4+: Check to gain time before your bishop is hit.
moves.13:Nxe4: Grab the central pawn; the knight is safe here.

evans.idea: White gives a pawn with b4 for quick development and a big centre. Take it, drop the bishop to a5 to keep the extra pawn, take on d4 and develop with ...Nf6 — don't get greedy beyond that.

moves.9:Ba5: Keep the bishop on the a5–e1 diagonal, pinning a later c3/d4.
moves.13:Nf6: Develop with tempo on e4 and get ready to castle.

ruy.idea: White pressures your e5 defender (the c6 knight). Kick the bishop with ...a6 and ...b5, develop with ...Nf6 and ...Be7, and castle into the solid Closed Ruy Lopez.

moves.5:a6: Ask the bishop straight away — you can always kick it later with ...b5.
moves.9:Be7: Quiet development; get ready to castle.
moves.11:b5: Kick the bishop now that Re1 threatens Bxc6 and Nxe5.
moves.13:O-O: King safe; the Closed Ruy main line.

scotch.idea: White opens the centre early with d4. Take, put the bishop on c5 to hit the d4 knight, add ...Qf6 for more pressure, and develop with ...Nge7 so the queen stays defended.

moves.5:exd4: Take — the pawn can't be held.
moves.7:Bc5: Hit the d4 knight straight away.
moves.9:Qf6: Add pressure on d4 and f2.

kings-gambit.idea: White gives the f-pawn to open the f-file. Take it, protect it with ...g5, and push ...g4 to chase the knight — if White sacrifices it (Muzio), take and defend with ...Qf6.

moves.3:exf4: Accept — the extra pawn is yours to keep.
moves.7:g4: Kick the knight away from e5 and h4.
moves.11:Qf6: Block the f-file and defend f4; you're a piece up.

danish.idea: White offers two pawns for fast development. You can take both, then give back material with ...Bb4+ and ...Nf6 to finish development — the Copenhagen Defence is safe and good for Black.

moves.7:cxb2: Take again so the c1 bishop can't recapture on c3.
moves.11:Nf6: Develop and get ready to castle.

sicilian.idea: Black fights for d4 from the side. Play the Open Sicilian: Nf3 and d4, take back with the knight, and when Black kicks it with ...e5, jump to b5 aiming at d6.

moves.0:e4: Take the centre and open lines for queen and bishop.
moves.4:d4: Open the centre — the main line.
moves.6:Nxd4: Take back with a centralised knight.
moves.8:Nb5: Hit d6, the hole ...e5 just created.
moves.10:N1c3: Develop and support the b5 knight.

french.idea: Black's light bishop is blocked by e6. Grab space with e5, support d4 with c3 and Nf3, and point your bishop at Black's kingside.

moves.4:e5: Gain space and cramp Black's kingside.
moves.8:Nf3: Defend d4 a second time and develop.

caro-kann.idea: Black is solid and wants to develop the light bishop before ...e6. Push e5 for space, trade off that bishop with Bd3, and develop with Ne2 so f-pawn and c-pawn stay free.

moves.6:Bd3: Offer a trade of Black's good bishop.
moves.8:Qxd3: Recapture; your queen is now active.
moves.10:Ne2: Develop flexibly; the knight can go to f4 or g3.

scandinavian.idea: Black brings the queen out early. Take on d5, then hit the queen with Nc3 to gain time, build the centre with d4 and develop Nf3 and Bc4.

moves.4:Nc3: Develop with tempo on the queen.
moves.6:d4: Take the centre while the queen is off-side.
moves.10:Bc4: Develop to an active diagonal and prepare to castle.

kid.idea: Black lets you take the centre and attacks it later with ...e5. Build e4/d4/c4, develop with Nf3 and Be2, and castle — the solid Classical system.

moves.10:Be2: Quiet development; get ready to castle.
moves.12:O-O: King safe before the centre opens.

pirc.idea: Black fianchettoes and attacks your centre later. Build it with d4 and Nc3, develop Nf3 and Bc4, castle, and if Black tries the ...Nxe4 trick, simply take back.

moves.12:Nxe4: Take the knight; Black's ...d5 fork wins it back, but you stay fine.
